Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqDec 17, 2024#Syria: a US drone fired a missile tonight on an undisclosed target on Armanaz-Kafr Takharim road in the N. #Idlib countryside.
No casualties currently reported.
Remains show a "Ninja" R9X missile was used.55221278K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJan 15, 2025#Syria: a US airstrike targeted a motorcycle near Sarmada, N. #Idlib.
There are casualties.4217514K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJan 15, 2025#Syria: target of US airstrike today in Sarmada (N. #Idlib) was a former #ISIS member called Mohamed Dhiban. He reportedly joined later Horas Al-Din.
A student was killed with him.
Remains show the R9X "Ninja" missile was used.
It's the 2nd US strike in one month (first failed).4216613K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJan 30, 2025#Syria: US carried out an airstrike tonight, targeting a car near Sarmada (N. #Idlib).
2-3 missiles were used.
No word on casualties so far.5186631K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJan 31, 2025#Syria (update): US claims to have killed a Horas Al-Din figure yesterday night following the drone strike in the N. #Idlib countryside.
One killed was confirmed by local sources, but not its ID.
Horas Al-Din announced its dissolution few days ago.
U.S. Central Command@CENTCOMJan 31, 2025CENTCOM Forces Kill Senior Operative of Terror Group Hurras al-Din, an Al-Qaeda Affiliate

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 15, 2025#Syria: tonight a US drone (MQ-9) strike destroyed a car on the M4 Highway near Ariha (S. #Idlib).
Target currently unknown.
3 drones were spotted monitoring monitoring the area.2145818K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 15, 2025#Syria: US drone strike killed 2 people in the car on the M4 Highway (S. #Idlib countryside).
Both are unidentified to date.3115014K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 16, 2025#Syria: 2 former Libyan commanders of Horas Al-Din were killed yesterday in the US drone strike against their vehicle in the S. #Idlib countryside.
Around 2018 Abu Abdul Rahman Al-Libi (photo) was the HaD commander of the Coastal sector.28489.7K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 21, 2025#Syria: another US drone strike targeted a car with a Ninja R9X missile in Dana (N. #Idlib).
At least one dead (driver).
Previous strike was 6 days ago.394937K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 21, 2025#Syria: Wassim Bayrqadar was the target of US drone strike today.
He was the former Internal Security Official of Horas Al-Din.5105319K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 23, 2025#Syria: observatories which once tracked Russian flights detect since last night an intense activity of US armed and reconnaissance drones over the N. #Idlib province.
5 areas area monitored 👇1135134K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 23, 2025#Syria: US just carried out another drone strike in #Idlib province.
A car near Killi was targeted with multiple Ninja R9X missiles.
The driver is dead.00:0000:00132210535K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 23, 2025#Syria: fragments of the missiles used today by US to kill a former Horas Al-Din member near Killi (N. #Idlib).
Those Hellfire missiles (R9X) use blades instead of explosives.
Impact point in the vehicle also pictured.13198930K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqFeb 23, 2025#Syria: the target of the US drone strike today was Abu Hussein Al-Turki.
He was once a Horas Al-Din commander but also worked with other groups like Ansar Islam as a military trainer.
He survived a previous US strike 5 months ago in Duwayr Akrad, NW. #Hama province.6177028K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiq#Syria: new US drone strike, this time in Jarabulus countryside (NE. #Aleppo).
A man on motorcycle was the target - he was killed.
It's the 4th US attack this month.1:37 PM · Feb 25, 202538.5KViews7177810
